## Documentation location
Link the file or section that needs attention.

## Issue
What is unclear, missing, incorrect, or outdated?

## Suggested improvement

## Why this matters
Explain who is affected and what they need to understand.

## Safety and privacy check
- [ ] I have not included patient-identifiable information.
- [ ] I have not included real prescriptions or medical records.
- [ ] Any clinical or regulatory statement is supported by an authoritative source.
